summary: Speed indicator for unknown-total progress tasks is implemented. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off), a static render_speed(speed) renderer, and a render branch for unknown totals; module-level track() gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column; Progress.track now leaves the total None for unsized iterables instead of raising; the two ValueError assertions were removed from tests; test_task_progress_column_speed was added; and a CHANGELOG line was added under Unreleased/Added. Nothing was run: tests, strict mypy, and black are unverified and should be run before merge. Nothing was committed.
